text: Shimiin arkhi, literally milk spirit, is on Mongolia's national intangible heritage list. Distilling is by an open or a closed set-up.

links.name: National Center for Cultural Heritage: Shimiin arkhi

steps.name: distil
steps.note: In a pot under an open-ended barrel, with a cast-iron pan of cold water on top, changed 2 times in one source and 2–4 times, by ferment level, in another.
